source.description: Provenance of this asset. ai_generated = produced by generate_image / LLM; user_uploaded = the brand owner provided the file (preserve as-is, never regenerate); shot = real photography / video capture; stock = licensed third-party asset. Downstream skills (05/07b/08) MUST NOT regenerate user_uploaded/shot/stock assets.

auto_tagged.description: True when sku_id / audience_ids / purpose / channel were proposed by AI (--existing-dir mode) and not yet confirmed by the user. UI should surface as 'AI 推荐 — 待复核'. Downstream skills MAY still consume these assets but should mark dependent decisions as provisional.

uploaded_at.description: ISO timestamp when the user uploaded this asset (only set for source=user_uploaded). Used by Web UI to sort/group recent uploads.

audience_ids.description: One asset can target multiple audiences (many-to-many). Empty/omitted = brand-level asset.

status.description: Production state. brief = direction only. stub = AI/placeholder generated. shot = real capture or final-quality render. retouched = post-processed. approved = signed off by brand. Site renders <Image> only when status ∈ {shot, retouched, approved}.

shoot_brief_md_path.description: Path to the markdown shot brief (relative to repo root). One file per asset under eec/04-creative-factory/asset_briefs/. REQUIRED for any asset with status != 'approved' so a real shoot can later happen. Self-check MUST verify the file exists on disk (per conventions.md §13).

delivered_file_path.description: Absolute path under /public (must start with /). Required when status >= shot. Examples: /og/asset_001.jpg, /videos/asset_005.mp4.

width.description: Pixel width — required for next/image when status >= shot.

height.description: Pixel height — required for next/image when status >= shot.

then.$comment: Per conventions.md §13: every brief/stub asset MUST point at a real .md brief on disk so a future shoot can actually happen. Self-check verifies file exists.

asset_coverage_matrix.description: Self-check: how many assets per (purpose × channel × language) intersection. Per conventions.md §13/§14: this matrix MUST be derived from filesystem reality (count actual files in repo/public/), not from the briefs[]. Aspirational matrices are forbidden — past incident: matrix claimed 15 assets shipped while only 1 existed.

asset_coverage_source.description: Locked to 'filesystem'. The skill MUST NOT compute asset_coverage_matrix from the briefs/spec — only from on-disk inventory of repo/public/.
